reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and it works fine for me, so I don't need one to carry around. The gym bag thing is cute but I'm not going to pay for a new format of something I already have.
objection: I have a bottle at home that I take before bed. A sachet to go solves a problem I don't have, and $30 a box feels like paying for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video where she shows a real situation I recognize, like skipping my night dose when I'm away or after a late gym session, plus a price closer to what my bottle costs.
